summary: Regex detectors for about a dozen surface properties; those perfectly label-aligned in both sample sets (six, then seven after a missed signoff variant was found by reading note endings) became candidates. On the 192 corpus notes, the gradient-reconstructed logit was regressed on the candidates and each coefficient divided by a keyword-labelled topic delta (and a sample-derived alternative), with 0.3 as the main-cue line. One 2x2 hand-written minimal-pair set per probe was scored by reconstruction and then by true logits. Latents for the single cue were ranked by gradient times corpus signoff delta, filtered by per-latent topic contribution, checked by simulated corpus ablation, sample-note ablation, a 40-latent comparison and a greedy alternative. The regex was checked against the detector.

phases.purpose: Read task info, sample-note files and corpus; print raw notes from samples and corpus.
Regex detectors for 12 surface properties: corpus frequencies, pairwise correlations, and alignment with label in each sample; six properties found perfectly aligned in both samples.
Both gradients; corpus activations in three chunks of 64; sample logits and sample activations by id; correlation/linear fit of true sample logits against F@g.
Enumerate parenthetical asides and quoted mottos in the corpus; keyword topic labels for corpus notes; OLS of F@g on the six candidates over the corpus with ratio to corpus topic-group delta.
Alternative topic denominator: sample L1-L0 reconstruction gap minus signed property coefficients.
Re-examine signoff and postscript: read note tails by label, list greetings and closing lines, list missed detections; add 'speak soon' and find signoff is a seventh perfectly aligned property.

Redo the OLS with seven candidates (two denominators, 0.3/0.15 flags); per-latent multivariate signoff coefficient times gradient for probe 0, cumulative top-k capture vs topic; probe 1 per-property ratios.

Write a 2x2 per probe (astronomy/birdwatching x signoff for probe 0; sailing/chess x lowercase/proper case for probe 1), verify detector fingerprints differ only in the toggled property, and score them by reconstruction.
True logits on the same 8 texts; ratio of property effect to topic effect per probe.
Rank latents by gradient times the crafted-pair signoff activation shift and inspect their crafted topic contributions (not used for the final set).
Simulated corpus mean-ablation: multivariate ranking with a per-latent topic cap (0.03, then 0.15); univariate signoff ranking with a greedy topic-keep >=82% rule; top-16..30 ceilings.
Ablate the 16 chosen latents on probe 0 sample notes: separation, accuracy, and difference of logit reduction between signoff and non-signoff notes.
Lock the 16 latents; build the closing-phrase regex; balanced accuracy vs the detector on corpus and both samples; list closing lines preceding a lone-name line to check vocabulary.
Ablate a 40-latent set (topic cap 0.1) on sample notes and compare captured signoff effect with the 16-latent set.
Build answer; second greedy pass allowing topic down to 85% returns the same set; validate format and submit.

probe_query_use.text_kind: 2x2 hand-written: one astronomy and one birdwatching paragraph (lowercase, 'he', no decorations), each with and without an appended two-line closing ('best,' + name)
probe_query_use.purpose: True-logit ratio of signoff effect to topic effect, to confirm the corpus-regression flag on probe 0.

probe_query_use.text_kind: 2x2 hand-written: one sailing and one chess paragraph, each in all-lowercase and in programmatic sentence case
probe_query_use.purpose: True-logit ratio of case effect to topic effect for probe 1's largest (borderline) candidate.

per_probe.conclusion: depends on a closing signoff line (e.g. 'cheers!', 'best,', 'speak soon') before a name
per_probe.procedure: After repairing the signoff detector, corpus OLS of F@g on seven aligned properties gave signoff a coefficient about 1.0-1.45 times the topic delta (other properties <0.18). A 2x2 minimal pair confirmed it in reconstruction (~0.53) and in true logits (~0.35). Latents: ranked by gradient times corpus signoff-vs-no-signoff activation difference, dropping latents whose gradient-weighted topic delta was >=0.15, top 16; simulated corpus ablation estimated 70% removal with topic kept; sample-note ablation, a 40-latent comparison (16 got 85% of it) and a greedy topic-keep pass agreed. Regex: closing-phrase alternation anchored to a whole line, BA 1.0 vs detector on corpus and samples.
per_probe.quote: Major finding: **signoff** has a huge dependence for probe 0 (ratio ~1.0–1.45), clearly a main cue.

per_probe.procedure: Corpus OLS ratios for all seven aligned properties stayed below 0.3 (largest: letter case ~0.18 corpus-denominator, ~0.12 sample-denominator; flagged borderline). Case was tested with a sailing/chess x lowercase/sentence-case 2x2: reconstruction ratio ~0.05 and true-logit ratio 0.064, so the probe was answered none.

caveats: Only two probes in this session. The sample-note ablation (step 60) used the set from the step-58 greedy pass, which equals the set locked at step 63; the script orders it after the final selection. The crafted-pair latent ranking (step 52) was inspected but its output was truncated and it did not feed the final set, so it is placed as abandoned. Exact keyword lists for topic labels changed slightly across steps; the later version is used. Several output blocks were truncated, so some intermediate numbers (e.g. probe 1 ratios for quote/dow in step 38) are not visible.
